facts.publicKinds: project_get_or_create/tag_get_or_create only; project_add/tag_add explicitly rejected by prepareChange
facts.validation: text trims, requires nonempty, raw length <=200; reused by internal add/edit
facts.identity: get_or_create matches same parent/name and returns existing without description overwrite; generatedId allocated after parent validation; owner receipt checked before prepare
facts.uniqueness: validateNodes prohibits any duplicate parent/name; SQL has root/parent unique indexes for Projects and Tags including empty names
facts.order: Project creates append within parent using durable order; Tag no durable order
facts.associations: Catalog creation itself does not assign Actions
facts.undo: Catalog creation delta, identity markers and receipt use existing atomic store; later edits/references cause conflict protection

payload.name: empty-capable trimmed string max raw 200 UTF-16
payload.parent_id: optional null or owner-scoped same-kind UUID

recommendedContract.semantics: Always distinct creation for empty name, named duplicate same parent rejected; get_or_create remains nonempty lookup-or-create
recommendedContract.editing: project_edit/tag_edit name empty-capable; generic text/ref/perspective validators remain nonempty
recommendedContract.migration: New migration replaces four name unique indexes with matching owner/parent indexes restricted to name != empty string. Preserve every existing row/id/order/history/receipt and all prior migration files. No table reset/rebuild needed.
recommendedContract.api: schemaVersion2 retained, MCP envelope adds existing two operation kinds, description explains directcreate/getorcreate distinction
recommendedContract.storage: No adapter/storage schema column or application port change needed; schema index definitions updated

requiredVerification: Multiple blank same-parent catalog creations distinct UUID and Project append order
Empty edit/clear valid; named uniqueness remains and owner isolation
Validation before ID allocation; caller ID rejected
Exact replay and missing response recover same IDs, no duplicate allocation
CAS competition and injected mid-batch failure preserve atomic receipts/markers/rows
Creation Undo clean removes only created catalog; later rename/membership/child references conflict
Populated migration preserves all rows and raw historical receipt bytes; SQL named uniqueness retained but blank duplicates allowed
